service_name: Solid Waste Management — Department Objectives & Vehicle Tracking
sub_service: Source segregation, primary/secondary collection, door-to-door vehicle tracking
description: SMC's Solid Waste Management department page states its objectives: source segregation and storage of recyclable waste, improved primary collection, mechanized daily cleaning, eliminating roadside dumping, modernized community waste storage synchronized with collection/transport, eliminating manual handling and open transport vehicles, additional semi-closed-body transfer stations, reducing landfill volume via processing technology, safe disposal of biomedical/C&D/E-waste, and public participation in segregation. SMC also runs a live public Door-to-Door Vehicle Tracking tool (at swm.suratmunicipal.org, login public/public) so citizens can check collection-vehicle status/location directly.
procedure: PROCEDURE NOT FOUND on this specific page for lodging an uncollected-garbage complaint -- SMC's site-wide general complaint form is at suratmunicipal.gov.in/OnlineServices/complaint/New (not SWM-specific). Citizens can independently check door-to-door collection-vehicle status via the public vehicle tracking tool.

sub_service: Streetlight repair, high-mast/decorative lighting, energy-efficiency maintenance
problem_type: Streetlight not working, damaged streetlight/high-mast fixture
department: Streetlight Department (part of Light & Energy Efficiency Cell), SMC — 8 zone offices + HQ
authority: Streetlight Department, SMC (decentralized via 8 zone offices, coordinated by HQ)
description: SMC's Streetlight service is delivered through 8 zone offices with policy/coordination handled by the Streetlight (HQ) department, part of the Light & Energy Efficiency Cell. Its stated functions: installation/operation/maintenance of all streetlights on SMC roads; installation/O&M of street/road lights on high masts at major traffic junctions; installation/O&M of decorative luminaries and poles; monitoring energy usage and implementing energy-efficiency measures; and minimizing non-burning streetlights via regular maintenance. The department's own site navigation lists a dedicated 'Non-working Streetlights' page (not itself fetched in this pass) alongside 'Streetlight Luminaires Details' and 'Energy Conservation and CCMS'.
